mapper.sql: log.id, log.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS actorName, log.original_assignee_user_id AS originalAssigneeUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(original_assignee.display_name, ''), original_assignee.username) AS originalAssigneeName, log.target_user_id AS targetUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(target_user.display_name, ''), target_user.username) AS targetUserName, log.action, log.from_status AS fromStatus, log.to_status AS toStatus, log.comment, log.created_at AS createdAt, u.avatar AS actorAvatar, u.updated_at AS actorUpdatedAt, NULL AS actorAvatarUrl

JOIN app_user u ON u.id = log.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN app_user original_assignee ON original_assignee.id = log.original_assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN app_user target_user ON target_user.id = log.target_user_id
